title: Anaphylaxis
text: Suspect it with sudden hives, swelling of lips or tongue, wheeze, or collapse after a sting, food or medicine.
Use the person's epinephrine auto-injector into the outer mid-thigh at once; call for the crew medical officer.
Lay the person flat with legs raised; sit them up only if breathing is hard, and roll to the side if vomiting.
Watch for a second wave for hours; any further medicine only as directed by the crew medical officer or mission protocol.
